themes_detail.label: Street condition crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street conditions in Fordham/University Heights have deteriorated sharply THIS WEEK, with 35 complaints filed vs. a baseline of 6.4 per week—a 449% spike (z-score: 12.51)—suggesting rapid pavement damage, potholes, or infrastructure failure requiring immediate investigation.
evidence: 35 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 6.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
449% spike with z-score of 12.51 (highest statistical severity in dataset)
Suggests acute, recent deterioration rather than chronic maintenance backlog
reporting_angles: Survey streets in Fordham and University Heights neighborhoods to document pothole locations and severity; compare to DOT maintenance schedules
Interview residents about how deteriorating street conditions are affecting daily life, vehicle damage, and pedestrian safety; tie to broader city budget cuts in sanitation

themes_detail.label: Illegal dumping surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints spiked THIS WEEK to 20 reports vs. a baseline of 4.5 per week—a 344% increase (z-score: 5.86)—indicating either a coordinated dumping operation or failure of enforcement in CD 205.
evidence: 20 illegal dumping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
344% spike with z-score of 5.86 (second-highest severity in dataset)
Aligns with CB budget request for increased sanitation trucks—suggests chronic capacity gap
reporting_angles: Map the 20 dumping locations from this week's complaints; identify if they cluster around transit corridors or vacant lots
Interview DSNY about enforcement capacity, response times, and whether this reflects citywide trends or a district-specific problem

themes_detail.label: Street and sidewalk noise explosion
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged THIS WEEK to 81 reports vs. a baseline of 19.8 per week—a 310% spike (z-score: 5.72)—suggesting construction, street vending, or event activity creating acute livability issues.
evidence: 81 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 19.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Occurs alongside vehicle noise spike 2 weeks ago (26 complaints vs. 5.4 avg), suggesting cumulative transportation and activity noise
reporting_angles: Document what's generating the noise surge—construction permits, street fairs, increased traffic, or enforcement gaps around street vending
Interview residents in high-complaint areas (Fordham Road corridor, major transit hubs) about quality-of-life impact and which times of day are worst

themes_detail.label: Food poisoning cluster
themes_detail.summary: Food poisoning complaints spiked LAST WEEK to 4 reports vs. a baseline of 0.1 per week—a 3100% increase (z-score: 11.72)—indicating a potential foodborne illness outbreak or multiple restaurant violations requiring immediate health department follow-up.
evidence: 4 food poisoning complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
3100% spike with z-score of 11.72 (second-highest statistical severity)
Suggests cluster event (common source) rather than isolated incidents
reporting_angles: Obtain DOH inspection records for restaurants in the area; identify whether complaints point to specific establishments or a pattern across multiple venues
Contact DOH to learn if they've identified a common source or pathogen; interview affected residents about symptoms and timeline to assess outbreak severity

themes_detail.label: Vehicle noise surge
themes_detail.summary: Vehicle noise complaints peaked 2 WEEKS AGO at 26 reports vs. a baseline of 5.4 per week—a 384% spike (z-score: 7.67)—suggesting either illegal street racing, modified exhaust vehicles, or traffic pattern changes that may be ongoing.
evidence: 26 vehicle noise complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 5.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Temporal proximity to street sweeping complaints (9 reports 2 weeks ago vs. 1.0 avg) suggests possible infrastructure work or event drawing vehicles
reporting_angles: Determine whether spike has subsided or is ongoing; if ongoing, investigate whether specific corridors (Grand Concourse, Fordham Road) are affected
Interview NYPD about enforcement activity and whether they've detected organized street racing or large gatherings contributing to noise
